0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East, 1-3 on the road) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, on a two-game winning streak) for the Nets' 9th game of the season, with Atlanta having one game still to play before this one. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Noah Clowney (day-to-day, knee soreness, game-time decision), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) and Jock Landale (hip) are day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Brooklyn was swept 0-4 by Atlanta in 2025-26, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
